questions.q: Which report should typically be run FIRST in a month-end reporting package's build order, before the headline financial statements?
options: The Income Statement
The Balance Sheet
The Trial Balance, to confirm debits equal credits before trusting anything built from those same balances
A customer statement
questions.explain: Running the Trial Balance first catches an out-of-balance condition while it's cheap to fix, before polished statements are built on potentially wrong numbers.

questions.q: Why should reconciliation reports (such as Payables-to-Ledger and bank statement reconciliation) be run before the Income Statement and Balance Sheet?
options: They have no bearing on the final statements
They confirm each subledger ties to the General Ledger, so statement balances have already been verified rather than potentially needing correction
Reconciliation reports can only be run after the statements, never before
Reconciliation is purely a Cash Management-only concern
questions.explain: Confirming subledger-to-GL ties before publishing the formal statements means the headline numbers are built on already-verified data.

questions.q: What is identified as the real skill tested by building a month-end reporting package well?
options: Memorizing every button in Financial Reporting Studio
Knowing the correct sequence — investigate first, reconcile next, publish last — not just knowing how to run each individual report
Only knowing how to use OTBI
Having the fastest internet connection
questions.explain: The lesson emphasizes that sequencing, not the mechanical difficulty of any single report, is what separates a competent consultant from a struggling one.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what should happen if the Trial Balance does not balance?
options: Proceed anyway and publish the Income Statement as scheduled
Stop and investigate (for example, with Account Analysis) before doing anything else
Ignore it since it rarely matters
Immediately rebuild the entire chart of accounts
questions.explain: An out-of-balance Trial Balance should halt the process for investigation before any further reports are produced.

questions.q: What is the next course in the Reporting & Data stage of the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path, after Oracle Financial Reporting?
options: Oracle Fusion Procure-to-Pay
Oracle Financials Data
Troubleshooting Oracle Financials
Oracle Fusion Security
questions.explain: Per the career path's Reporting & Data stage, Oracle Financial Reporting is followed by Oracle Financials Data, then SQL for Oracle Financials.
